facts.function: automatic control of engine parameters (valve actuation and electronic engine control)
facts.form: integrated valve actuator, single-speed electronic engine controller, digital controllers

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9032 automatic regulating or controlling instruments; chapter 90 note 7 defines 9032; note 1(g) excludes valves of heading 8481

rejected_alternatives.reason: valve with electric actuator; the item is an engine control actuator/controller, not a pipe valve (uncertain)
DC motor only if actuator is just a motor; here integrated with electronics

missing_facts: Whether the integrated valve actuator is a plain valve-plus-motor (8481) or an electronic controller with actuator
Classify separately: APECS 500 controller, APECS digital controllers
classification.rationale: Engine speed/fuel control actuators and controllers that automatically regulate a variable fall in 9032.89 per ruling K89109 (controller and complete governor system 9032.89.6085). Several articles are named, the first being an integrated valve actuator; I assumed the set is electronic engine control equipment of heading 9032.
